tasks.short: Design databases for geographic and topographic data.

steps.what: Design or develop geographic and topographic data.
Draft information databases that include those features.

loop.input: the features the technician named, geographic or topographic
loop.output: table and field names that use only those features
loop.check: every field must trace to a named feature; else discard
loop.stop: one draft; an unnamed feature is not added
loop.why_not_simpler: which data the database holds is the decision

steps.what: Accept or change the drafted structure.

tasks.design: The technician designs which geographic and topographic data to include. A structure may be drafted only from those features. {DATA_PLATFORM} creates the empty databases after the technician accepts the structure. The draft does not decide the contents.
tasks.previous_blocker: Database layouts were drawn in a note and rebuilt by hand in the map store.
tasks.enabler_now: A named feature can become a field. Which features belong cannot.
tasks.still_hard: A feature that does not fit a table, or a need the technician has not named, stays a decision.
tasks.human_edge: The technician knows which attribute the later maps will actually ask for.
tasks.altitude: Creating the empty store takes less rebuilding. Designing the contents and accepting the structure stay.

reach.task: Load data only into the accepted structure

evidence.claim: Creating empty tables from an accepted field list is a setup. Choosing the geographic contents is not.

assumptions: Workflow boundary: the technician designs the structure. Loading survey points is a different task.
Structured input: feature name, whether it is geographic or topographic, field type. Producer is the technician. A field with no named feature is not created.
The decision is remaining time. The store starts empty.
unknowns: Who else must use these tables?
research_questions: How often is a database rebuilt because a needed feature was missing?

already_counted.description: Designing the contents is already the remaining time on that step.

approvals.approved_version: structure the technician accepted for that database

time_saved_range_pct.basis: If the features are not named, nothing is created and the design stays a note. Provisional.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Describe boundaries from existing property information.

steps.what: Find existing property information for the parcels.
Research those records against adjacent properties.

tasks.design: Existing property information is found by parcel. Researching it against adjacent properties, combining splits and combinations, and describing boundaries and boundary adjustments stay the technician's writing. The description is not a title determination. A record that is missing is shown as missing.
tasks.previous_blocker: Boundary descriptions were rewritten from the last deed without the neighbouring parcel.
tasks.enabler_now: Finding a stored record is a search. Describing the boundary is not.
tasks.still_hard: A split the records disagree on, or an adjustment with no source, stays research.
tasks.human_edge: The technician can see which call belongs to the adjacent parcel.
tasks.altitude: Finding indexed records takes less hunting. Research, the splits and the description stay.

reach.task: Read the description before any boundary opinion

evidence.claim: A search by parcel id returns records. It does not describe a boundary.
Describing a boundary can affect neighbours. The source pack does not name the cadastral statute. This note is not a title determination.

assumptions: Workflow boundary: the technician researches and describes. A licensed surveyor determines the boundary. This task does not certify title.
Structured input: parcel id, adjacent parcel id, record id, split or combination. Producer is the record store. A description does not add a record that was not found.
Research time stays. A missing record is not filled.
unknowns: Who may turn this note into a boundary determination?
research_questions: How often is a description written without the neighbouring parcel?

already_counted.description: Researching the records is already the remaining time on that step.

incremental.description: Retire descriptions when a later survey replaces them.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: If records are not indexed, the search is thin and the research stays on paper. Provisional.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Calculate curvature, closures, azimuths and marker placement.

steps.what: Perform calculations to determine earth curvature corrections.
Compute traverse closures, adjustments and azimuths.
Apply atmospheric impacts and placement of markers.
Review measurements and level runs outside tolerance.

tasks.design: Booked measurements and a reference table feed curvature corrections, traverse closures, adjustments, azimuths, atmospheric impacts and marker placement on {DATA_PLATFORM}. Level runs outside tolerance are reviewed. A sketch is not calculated. A result that fails is not forced to close.
tasks.previous_blocker: The same corrections were computed by hand, and a bad level run was found late.
tasks.enabler_now: Rows of angles, distances and a tolerance are arithmetic.
tasks.still_hard: A run that does not close, or a table for the wrong conditions, stays a review.
tasks.human_edge: The technician knows which setup the residual is pointing at.
tasks.altitude: The arithmetic takes less time. The review of a failed run stays. Unbooked notes are not calculated.

evidence.claim: Curvature, closures and azimuths from booked measurements are a calculation. The source pack names survey software that adjusts a traverse. This is the pattern, not a measured case here.

assumptions: Workflow boundary: the technician calculates from booked measurements. Collecting them is a different task. Placing a marker in the ground is field work, not this calculation.
Structured input: measurement id, angle, distance, table id. Producer is the field log. A missing distance stops that leg.
The review is remaining time. No figure is invented to force a close.
unknowns: Which table covers atmosphere and curvature?
research_questions: How often does a hand level run fail to close?

already_counted.description: Reviewing a failed run is already the remaining time on that step.

incremental.description: Retire results computed on a withdrawn table.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: If the measurements are sketches, nothing is calculated and the review does not start. Provisional.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Compare survey computations with standards for adequacy.

steps.what: Compare survey computations with applicable standards.
List computations that miss those standards.
Determine the adequacy of the data.
Mark the data adequate only after that.

tasks.design: Survey computations are compared with the applicable standards, and the misses are listed. The technician determines adequacy. {PROJECT} marks the data adequate only after that decision. A pass against a number is not the adequacy finding.
tasks.previous_blocker: Standards were checked by ticking a paper list, and a miss was found at issue.
tasks.enabler_now: A number outside a stated limit can be listed. Whether the data are adequate cannot.
tasks.still_hard: A standard that does not apply, or a miss the technician accepts with a reason, stays a decision.
tasks.human_edge: The technician knows which standard this survey was actually under.

ambition.what: New computations are compared when they land, and a miss is visible before the data are marked adequate.

tasks.altitude: Listing misses takes less ticking. Determining adequacy stays. Nothing is marked adequate by the comparison alone.

reach.task: See computations that were not marked adequate

evidence.claim: Comparing a number with a stated limit is a check. Determining adequacy is not.

assumptions: Workflow boundary: the technician compares and determines adequacy. Issuing the survey is a different task.
Structured input: computation id, standard id, limit, value. Producer is the calculation store and the standards file. A computation with no standard id is listed as unchecked.
The decision is remaining time. A miss is not deleted to clear the list.
unknowns: Are the standards written as limits?
research_questions: How often is data issued with a standard still unchecked?

already_counted.description: Determining adequacy is already the remaining time on that step.

incremental.description: Retire adequacy marks when the computations are replaced.

approvals.approved_version: adequacy decision the technician made for those computations

time_saved_range_pct.basis: If standards are not stored as limits, the comparison is empty and the technician still determines adequacy. Provisional.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

role.altitude: Database contents are chosen, then an empty store is created. Boundary descriptions are researched, not generated, and they are not a title. Curvature and closures run on booked rows. Adequacy is a decision, and a comparison does not mark the data by itself.
reach: The party chief loads data only into an accepted structure.
A failed level run is visible before the result is used.
skills_to_grow: Name the feature before a table is created.
Leave a missing adjacent record as missing.
role.ambitious_version: A new computation is compared when it lands, and a boundary note shows which neighbour was not found.
